command: pre-registration: PLAN_PARTS Layer 2 confirmatory read, rank-32 parts (POST-HOC re-registration)

metrics.S1: pp_l2's: holds iff swap tests exactly 0 (every seed) and every tg component exactly 0 on every frame
metrics.S2: pp_l2's: holds iff in both layouts 3F (every N1-N6 D3 CI contains 0) and object-matched ratio >= 0.8 with CI lower bound >= 0.6
metrics.S3_layer3_go: pp_l2's: S1 and S2 hold and, for bottle and plate, both layouts, every k in {1, 5, 10}: transfer ratio >= 0.8 with CI lower bound >= 0.6
metrics.S4: descriptive: HF, HL, RF, LIB exactly as pp_l2 (rank 8), at seeds 10-12 on the same fresh states
metrics.architecture: P with rank-32 parts (parts_flow.PartsFlow rank=32); build recipe and creation recipe of pp_l2 (30,000 steps AdamW 3e-4 batch 512 EMA 0.999; creation 4,000 steps AdamW 3e-4 batch 256 no EMA)
metrics.held_out: bottle (obj, created from K4), plate (tgt, created from K1); k in {1, 5, 10, 50}
metrics.multiplicity: 95% CIs as pp_l2; Layer-3 GO is an intersection-union test (every cell must pass), so no Holm adjustment is applied
metrics.states: pp_conf_states: 50 fresh start states per layout (familiar seeds 9100000+k, new 9200000+k, noise 23000000+1000k), never used by any earlier read
metrics.status: PRE-REGISTERED PLAN_PARTS Layer 2 confirmatory read (docs/PARTS_RESULTS.md section 6); POST-HOC: rank 32 chosen after seeing pp_l2's rank-8 and rank-32 development results
metrics.written_before: the S1 read and any rollout of this read
